selection.reason: The front bumper fascia, EPP absorber and lower stiffener make up the bumper test zone, so they directly determine the lower/upper legform impact results required for M1 vehicles.
The front bumper is the front protective device of an M1 vehicle, and its behaviour in the low-speed collision test governs whether safety-relevant parts such as lighting are protected.
The fascia, grill, licence plate holder, towing cover and sensor housings are external projections of an M1 car and must meet the radius and projection limits.
The bumper beam and lower stiffener are part of the front crash structure, so they influence occupant protection in the offset frontal impact test.
The bumper's energy-management structure affects the crash pulse in the full-width frontal impact test for M1 vehicles.
The bumper integrates electrical/electronic sub-assemblies (radar, LIDAR, camera, PDC, sensor heating, keyless aerial, lighting) that must meet EMC emission and immunity requirements.
The integrated signalling lamps (e.g. side marker, direction indicator, position or daytime running lamps) need component approval as light-signalling devices.
Installation of the bumper-integrated signalling and functional lamps on the M1 vehicle must follow R48 position, visibility and switching rules, and decorative lighting must not conflict with them.
The EV charge port housed in the bumper forms part of the vehicle inlet, which is subject to R100 electric-shock protection and post-crash electrical safety requirements.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the functional lighting integrated in the bumper includes front fog lamps or cornering lamps, these need approval as road illumination devices.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the front radar/camera carried by the bumper is used for advanced emergency braking, its mounting and the radome affect AEBS detection performance.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the bumper radar/LIDAR supports driver control assistance functions such as adaptive cruise, the DCAS requirements apply to the system they feed.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the bumper PDC/radar sensors serve as the forward detection means of an acceleration control for pedal error system on an automatic M1 vehicle, R175 applies.
verworfen (nur Fahrzeugebene): The connected ECUs of the radar, camera and keyless aerial fall within the vehicle's cyber security management.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the bumper's sensor ECUs (radar, camera) are software-updatable, they are covered by the vehicle's software update management system.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the keyless-entry aerial is also used for key authentication by the immobilizer, it forms part of the immobilizer system approved under R162.
This is a global technical regulation transposed into UN R127 for type approval, so R127 is selected instead.
It covers rear-end collision behaviour, but the component is a front bumper.
The PC/PMMA radomes and lighting lenses are not windscreens or panes, and glazing for lighting devices is excluded from scope.
Its anti-theft and alarm provisions have been split into R161, R162 and R163, which supersede it.
It applies only to M2, M3, N2 and N3, whereas the vehicle is M1 (covered by R152).
